question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or solve long-prompt friction through inline growth/resizing and send-shortcut preferences instead?
rationale: This is new user-facing composer UX with draft, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics rather than a broken existing contract, and related work only covers shortcut behavior.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit expanded editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Ergonomics
options.body: Use auto-grow, resizing, and the send-shortcut path to improve long prompts without adding a modal editing mode.

options.title: Decline This UX Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the core composer should stay lean and modal composition should not be added.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit expanded editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.
